problem: The team reads clips for ninety minutes on Monday and leaves with a different story about the week than the one the data supports.

ritual.name: Monday coverage review
ritual.moment: first item, before anyone opens a browser

trigger: the scheduler runs at 06:00 Monday; the digest is on the shared drive before 07:00
format: one page: five items that matter, why each matters, and who else carried the story

metric.name: review time to reach a decision
metric.target: 90 minutes down to 30, within four weeks
metric.source: meeting start and end time, logged by the chair

stops: printing the raw clips list for the meeting
the separate spreadsheet where each officer kept their own count

failure_modes.mitigation: the digest is the first agenda item; the chair opens it on screen

failure_modes.mode: The team trusts the score more than the story
failure_modes.mitigation: every item prints its reasons; one story is read in full each week
the old clips list is withdrawn in week two, same day as go-live

fallback: Revert to the manual list for two weeks, then diagnose whether the failure was the tool or the ritual.
